newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end lower on technology sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end lower on technology sell-off.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower on Wednesday, as investors continued to sell technology shares on fears of disappointing industry earnings.
Based on early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 42.49 points to close at 7,269.66, after falling more than 50 points earlier.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a 13-10 margin on volume of about 469 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq composite index fell 5.27 points to 1,379.64.
